system.boundary: Build a battery-fed electric axle-drive model in Simulink for a 1100 kg vehicle.
engineering_objects: The physical power path must include a high-voltage DC source, DC link, controlled three-phase converter, interior permanent-magnet synchronous motor, fixed 9:1 gear reduction, differential/axle load, wheels, and finite-mass longitudinal vehicle dynamics.

The exact current-controller realization, coordinate transforms, switching abstraction, and torque-control equations are not prescribed, but the electrical feedback path and electromechanical/vehicle energy path must be causal and connected.

The model should track achievable torque, remain finite under every declared scale pair, accelerate under positive demand, enter generating torque under braking, and show a physically consistent change in final speed when braking is reduced.
physical_paths: The physical power path must include a high-voltage DC source, DC link, controlled three-phase converter, interior permanent-magnet synchronous motor, fixed 9:1 gear reduction, differential/axle load, wheels, and finite-mass longitudinal vehicle dynamics.

A connected drive controller must convert the driver's accelerator and brake requests into a bounded torque reference and regulate the motor through measured phase currents and rotor/electrical state.
Acceleration and regenerative braking torque must act through the converter, motor, gear, and vehicle path; prescribed vehicle speed or replayed torque/current trajectories are not valid.

The exact current-controller realization, coordinate transforms, switching abstraction, and torque-control equations are not prescribed, but the electrical feedback path and electromechanical/vehicle energy path must be causal and connected.

interfaces.name: driver_input
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named driver_input, motor_torque, phase_currents, and vehicle_speed. driver_input has width 2 in this order: applied accelerator and brake, both unitless fractions. driver_input must contain the applied, clipped accelerator and brake profiles.

interfaces.name: motor_torque
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named driver_input, motor_torque, phase_currents, and vehicle_speed. motor_torque has width 4 in this order: controller torque reference, actual shaft torque, controller-estimated torque, and symmetric torque limit, all in N*m. motor_torque must contain the controller reference, actual shaft torque, controller-estimated torque, and symmetric torque limit.

interfaces.name: phase_currents
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named driver_input, motor_torque, phase_currents, and vehicle_speed. phase_currents has width 3 in this order: phase-a, phase-b, and phase-c current, all in A. phase_currents must be the actual three-phase currents in the motor drive.

interfaces.name: vehicle_speed
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named driver_input, motor_torque, phase_currents, and vehicle_speed. vehicle_speed has width 1: vehicle speed in km/h. vehicle_speed must come from the finite-mass vehicle state.
